title.zh: 建筑维护与分层管理（小型管理公司——豁免）命令 2018
title.en: Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Small Management Corporations — Exemption) Order 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Small Management Corporations — Exemption) Order 2018 and comes into operation on 1 February 2019.
2. In this Order, “small management corporation” means a management corporation constituted for a strata title plan with 10 or fewer lots.

3.—(1) An individual who is elected at a general meeting of a small management corporation as a treasurer or secretary of the small management corporation is not ineligible under section 53(9A)(a) of the Act for election or re‑election to office as a chairperson of that small management corporation.
(2) An individual who is elected at a general meeting of a small management corporation as a chairperson or secretary of the small management corporation is not ineligible under section 53(9A)(b) of the Act for election or re‑election to office as a treasurer of that small management corporation.
(3) An individual who is elected at a general meeting of a small management corporation as a chairperson or treasurer of the small management corporation is not ineligible under section 53(9A)(c) of the Act for election or re-election to office as a secretary of that small management corporation.
4. An individual in a small management corporation is not ineligible under section 53(9B) of the Act for re-election to office as a treasurer of the small management corporation.

5.—(1) An individual who is already elected or appointed as the treasurer or secretary of the council of a small management corporation is not ineligible under section 55(7)(a) of the Act for appointment as a chairperson by the council of the small management corporation.
(2) An individual who is already elected or appointed as the chairperson or secretary of the council of a small management corporation is not ineligible under section 55(7)(b)(i) of the Act for appointment as a treasurer by the council of the small management corporation.
(3) An individual who is already elected or appointed as the chairperson or treasurer of the council of a small management corporation is not ineligible under section 55(7)(c) of the Act for appointment as a secretary by the council of the small management corporation.
(4) An individual in a small management corporation is not ineligible under section 55(7)(b)(ii) of the Act for re-appointment as a treasurer of the council of the small management corporation.
6. The Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Exempt Treasurers) Order (O 1) is revoked.
